# QC02: 迎晖殿 Yinghui Dian

Wave 4 · Qichun Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=QC02` · Page: `/scenes/#QC02` · Row: `research/buildings/QC02-yinghui-dian/`

## What it was

迎晖殿 Yinghui Dian, "Hall Welcoming the Sunlight", the main hall inside the south gate of Qichun Yuan, called 勤政殿 under Jiaqing and begun in 1809 (E0572, E0567). North of it is the seven-bay 中和堂, then the path past the hill to the dowager's quarter at 敷春堂 (E0572, E0524). Under Daoguang the dowager received birthday homage here (E0568, E0572); it is named as the main hall of the dowager's residence (S223; E0448), and the coffin of the dowager 康慈 lay here in 1855 (E0625). Burned in October 1860 (E0680). The terrace remains; the gate in front was rebuilt in 1986 (E0568).

From the inventory row: **built** 1809 as 勤政殿; **changed** 勤政殿 under Jiaqing, renamed 迎晖殿 under Daoguang; **destroyed** 1860 (S06, S01, S224, S223, S361).

## What survives today

The park page of 2011 says the terrace of 迎晖殿 remains while the gates in front were rebuilt in 1986 (E0568); the status table of about 2011 lists 迎晖殿 among the rebuilt sites (E0569). One ruin photograph of a broken bridge is tied to it as likely (P0420).

No excavation or survey of its remains found in this round.
